pages.title: Fake A Smokes, B contact
pages.body:
Three smokes needed for the player who goes A - the A exec should be thrown quite early, since CTs may push mid and they will get lots of information. Exec before 1:35 should prevent that, together with smokes being thrown, T from ramp will flash A twice around 1:30. 

At this point, when smokes land the A player throws one "lamp flash" and goes towards ramp, with the deep stairs/jungle flash. This should allow him to fight with anyone from A site, preventing the smoke push from CT players. Once that player is getting on site, Ts from B house slowly come close to windows in B house and go out as fast as possible once they are seen.

Afterplant - depending on killed B players, plant can be for short with strong short/edward hold, or default with players on bench, site, and house - last player might look for kills on short or in kitchen.
